issuing_body: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases

treatments.name: Healthy lifestyle (eating plan and physical activity)
treatments.summary: Many people can manage blood glucose through a healthy eating plan and regular physical activity.

evidence.quote: Many people are able to do this by living a healthy lifestyle.
evidence.statement: Many people can manage their blood glucose with a healthy lifestyle.

evidence.quote: A healthy lifestyle includes following a healthy eating plan and getting regular physical activity.
evidence.statement: A healthy lifestyle means a healthy eating plan and regular physical activity.

treatments.name: Diabetes medicines including insulin
treatments.population: People with type 2 diabetes who cannot reach glucose goals with lifestyle alone
treatments.summary: Oral medicines, insulin and other injectables are used; some people need more than one medicine over time.

evidence.quote: Medicines for diabetes include oral medicines, insulin, and other injectable medicines. Over time, some people will need to take more than one type of medicine to control their diabetes.
evidence.statement: Medicines include oral agents, insulin and other injectables, often in combination over time.

treatments.name: Blood glucose self-monitoring
treatments.summary: Regular blood glucose checks at a frequency set by the provider.

evidence.quote: You will need to check your blood glucose regularly. Your provider will tell you how often you need to do it.
evidence.statement: People with type 2 diabetes check their blood glucose regularly as advised.

treatments.name: Blood pressure and cholesterol control
treatments.summary: Keeping blood pressure and cholesterol near provider-set targets is part of management.

evidence.quote: It's also important to keep your blood pressure and cholesterol levels close to the targets your provider sets for you.
evidence.statement: Blood pressure and cholesterol should be kept near individual targets.

notes: Consumer health summary; no recommendation strengths or evidence levels.
